name: Zoar Limited
summary: Zoar Limited, a pharmaceutical company, engages in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and intermediates in Africa, the Middle East, India, Central and South America, Asia, and Europe. The company offers APIs for oncology, cardiovascular and respiratory diseases, diabetes, central nervous system disorders, and neurological disorders. It also provides drug contract development and manufacturing services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Hung Hom, Hong Kong.
